turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have a client call at 4:40, so tell me why my son has a zero in the gradebook.
Thanks for coming in.
Thanks is noted. Don't waste it. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Did anyone call me before that went into the system?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
"Owen's essay." Okay. Then answer my question first. Did anyone call me before the zero went into the system, yes or no?
How has his semester been at home?
That's not what this meeting is about. You've put a zero on his record and you haven't answered whether you called me first. Yes or no, Hale.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Tired." I'm not here to discuss my son's sleep with his teacher. Yes or no: did you call me before you entered the zero?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Keep my son's job out of this. I've asked you one question three times now. Did you call me before the zero went in?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
I'm writing down that you didn't answer. Ten minutes left. Did you call me before the zero went in, or didn't you?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Concerns." Concerns are not a procedure. Your own school's procedure says the parent gets called before any mark consequence is entered. Did that happen?
The school's checker flagged it.
A checker flagged it. That's a machine's opinion, Hale. The company that sells that software says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Okay. Then the score can't carry a zero by itself. What else do you have?
I also looked at the version history.
Show me. Turn the screen around. Exact times, Hale.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." That's not a time. Give me the actual times, and show me the document.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." I'm writing that down, and I want the numbers next to it. How many words, and at what times?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
Asked him what? Did he get to explain his argument, or did you decide he couldn't before you wrote the zero?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Had trouble." He's seventeen and you asked him in a hallway, Hale. Does his English teacher's question count as an examination now?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
He's already in trouble. There's a zero in the gradebook with his name on it. Your intentions aren't on the record, the zero is. What do you want from this meeting?
What do you think should happen next?

You're asking me how to do your job? I'll tell you what I want. The zero comes out of the gradebook today. And any re-do happens privately, not in front of his class, with nothing going on his file. Put that in writing.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not coaching the teacher across from me. You have my position. Withdraw the zero, keep it private, and nothing goes on his file. Are you willing to write that down?
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.

Okay. Rewrite, then. Private, supervised, outside his class time, and the mark replaces the zero. Nothing about this goes on his record, not a note, not a flag. If you can put that in an email to me tonight, we can talk about the details.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Lunch is fine, as long as nobody else knows why he's there. And "nothing on his file" goes in the email too, in those words. I'm waiting.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." That's a condition you're putting on my son, not a promise. Nothing on file, period, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal right now.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email. Tonight, copy the principal. Then we'll see.
Thanks for your time.
We're not finished. Nothing on his file, in writing, and the zero is coming out of the gradebook. Until I see that, I'm not leaving.
